$comment: Traceability: approvals table (data-model.md) and contract-map row 'approval state machine, server-time expiry, single-transaction consumption' (control-core-unification.md §4). This is verb 2 of 4: request approval decisions (blocking). Hangs off the LiveClient onRequest callback path (Phase 3). The worker proposes; the service creates the approvals row, computes expiry on the server clock, and replies exactly once with service.approval.decision. propose-while-pending is rejected with propose_while_pending. Canonical action form for the digest: UTF-8 JSON, object keys sorted lexicographically, no insignificant whitespace; digest = sha256 hex of that form. The service recomputes the digest from the action; the worker recomputes it too and verifies the echo in the decision (ChangedAction protection at the seam).

msg_type.description: Wire discriminator: names the message type. Added in the Phase 1 edit (2026-09-18); the Phase 0 schemas pinned no discriminator, and service.error already used "message" for human-readable text, so routing on "message" was impossible.

action.description: The exact action the worker wants to perform, in the journal's propose semantics.

arguments.description: Bounded action arguments. The service canonicalizes and digests these; the digest binds proposal to decision to dispatch.

description_user.description: User-safe, human-readable description of the proposed action for the approval prompt. Never includes secrets or raw provider internals.

ttl_ms.description: Worker-proposed time-to-live, bounded like the M0 journal (1-300000 ms). The service may clamp it down; expiry is always evaluated on the server clock.

title: worker.approvals.request-decision
